raw_segments.text: Marfa Ignatievna, the wife of old Grigory, who had been knocked senseless near the fence,
was sleeping soundly in her bed and might well have slept till morning after the draft
But all of A. sudden she wake up, no doubt roused by a fearful epileptic scream from
Smurdiakov, who was lying in the next room unconscious.
That scream always preceded his fits and always terrified and upset Marfa Ignatievna.
She could never get accustomed to it.
She jumped up and ran half awake to Smurdiakov's room, but it was dark there, and she could
only hear the invalid beginning to gasp and struggle.
Then Marfa Ignatievna herself screamed out and was going to call her husband, but suddenly
realized that when she had got up, he was not beside her in bed.
She ran back to the bedstead and began groping with her hands, but the bed was really empty.
Then he must have gone out.
She ran to the steps and timidly called him.
She got no answer, of course, but she caught the sound of groans far away in the garden
The groans were repeated, and it was evident they came from the garden.
